dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier de l isere talus

description: Réseau routier de l’Isère – Talus is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Données non vérifiées, relevées en 2019. Ce jeu de données représente le relevé de la présence de talus montants (amont) et descendants (aval) en bord de Route Départementale (RD) sur le territoire administratif du département de l'Isère. Cette couche ne donne pas d'indication sur la propriété. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are Routes, Environnement, 2019, Isère. The portal shows 11,973 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
